question: In March 2022, Pramod Sawant became the _________ Chief Minister of Goa.
solution:
The correct answer is __**13th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr Pramod Sawant** is an Indian politician and the **13th **and current Chief Minister of Goa.
 
• Sawant represents the **Sanquelim **constituency in the Goa Legislative Assembly and is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• **Dayanand Bandodkar** was the **first **CM of the UT of Goa in 1963.
 
• After the **56th Amendment Act,1987** of the Indian Constitution, the union territory was split, and Goa was made India's twenty-fifth state, with Daman and Diu remaining a union territory

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b42a4b37e75badddf7328b247ce6357ca0a5ecc18f4185b195b52cba138a5392.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governor of Goa** - Sh Sreedharan Pillai
 
• **Goa Statehood Day** - 30th May 1987
 
• **Capital **- Panaji
 
• **Official Language** - Konkani
 
• **National Parks** - Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary, Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
